title: To rescind appropriations provided to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement and U.S. Customs and Border Protection by the One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act, and for other purposes.

la.text: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committees on Ways and Means, and Homeland Security, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
